Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the department of agriculture to accept and expend gifts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authority of the department of agricultureto accept and expend gifts; and adding a new section to chapter 43.23RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director of the department may accept, expend, and retaingifts, grants, bequests, or contributions from public or privatesources to carry out the purposes and programs of the department.
